evidence.title: GitHub - vitejs/vite: Next generation frontend tooling. It's fast! · GitHub

name: Vite
summary: Frontend build tool with an instant dev server, fast HMR and a Rolldown-powered production build.
description: Vite is a build tool for modern web projects in two parts: a dev server that serves native ES modules with extremely fast Hot Module Replacement, and a build command that bundles with Rolldown into optimized static assets. It is extensible through a universal plugin API and fully typed JavaScript APIs, and ships alongside create-vite project templates and @vitejs/plugin-legacy for older browsers.
contains: instant server start and lightning fast HMR
universal plugin interface and fully typed APIs
